It thoundth like a thweet deal to me, but a friend told me the theller might be a thcammer.

Can you pleathe check it out? The theller'th name ith NaijeerianConsular419 and he claimth he ith in a new ectoBay depot on Level 3 of MutantMania. Pleathe help me!
